spans.s:
m. (-गः)
1 A bird.
2 An arrow.
3 The sun.
4 A planet.
5 A deity.
6 Air, wind.
7 A grasshopper.
E.
ख the sky, &c. and ग who goes.

m. (-तिः)
A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
खग a bird, and पति lord or chief.

m. (-मः)
A bird.
E.
ख and गम what goes.

m. (-क्त्रः)
A tree, commonly Lakucha, (Artocarpus lacucha.)
E.
खग a bird, and वक्त्र face, bird-faced.

f. (-ती)
The earth.
E.
खग a bird, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-त्रुः)
A plant, commonly Chakuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)
E.
खग a bird, and शत्रु an enemy.

n. (-नं)
1 The hollow of a tree.
2 A bird's nest.
E.
खग a bird, स्थान place.

m. (-कः)
A hawk, a falcon.
E.
खग, and अन्तक destroyer^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-नः)
1 The eastern mountain over which the sun rises.
2 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
खग a bird or the sun, and आसन seat or place of abiding.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
खग, and इन्द्र chief.

m. (-जः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
खगेन्द्र, and ध्वज emblem.

m. (-रः)
GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU; also खगेश.
E.
खग, and ईश्वर king of birds.

m. (-डः)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)

m. (-लः)
1 The vault or circle of the heavens, the planisphere.
2 The same represented artificially, the armillary sphere.
E.
ख, and गोल sphere.

f. (-द्या)
Astronomy.
E.
खगोल, and विद्या knowledge.
